Name: Pastel buildings
Author: Mechapugs
Description:
This mod replaces the buildings on your farm and makes them shades of pink, white, and purple. it replaces the all stages of the houses, the regular, big, and deluxe barn, the regular, big, and deluxe coop, the stable, the well, the silo, and the shed.

To install, you should probably make a backup of the original buildings first, if you haven't already. This mod will replace the files of the original buildings. 
Next, simply go to Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Buildings, and drag the unzipped files into the folder. Your computer will ask for permission the replace the building files, and after you accept this you will have shiny new pretty buildings!
